name: Team Meeting
description: Recap a conversation between two people or a small group without assuming a formal meeting process.

sections.title: Meeting Overview
sections.instruction: Summarize what this one-on-one or group conversation covered, and mention its purpose or outcome only when the recording makes them clear.

sections.title: Discussion
sections.instruction: Capture the main topics, viewpoints, and useful details. Attribute a point to someone only when the speaker is clear; do not assume job roles, a fixed agenda, or a particular team method.

sections.title: Agreements & Open Questions
sections.instruction: Include agreements and unresolved questions when they matter. Clearly distinguish what was settled from what is still being considered; omit this section if neither applies.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List only follow-up actions explicitly agreed or assigned, with owner and timing only when stated. Omit this section when no actions were agreed.
